Director of Healthcare Partnerships

Hireology  •  Chicago, IL or Remote  •  Full-Time

About Hireology

Hireology’s technology helps businesses build great teams. Over the last 16 years, we’ve grown from a startup to a market-leading organization with 140 team members and built an award-winning culture that makes this company an amazing place to work.

About the Role

It’s with that in mind that Hireology is looking to add a Director of Healthcare Partnerships to our team. This is a critical pipeline-generating role, built on leveraging deep operator-level influence to drive meaningful growth.

The Director of Healthcare Partnerships is responsible for leading business and partnership development across our healthcare business. You will work with our Chief Revenue Officer and members of the broader team to architect the market development strategy and drive the execution of that strategy to propel the business forward. Hireology has built a strong position in post-acute care, including Home and Home Health Care, Senior Living, Long Term Care, Hospice, and Community Living. We are now extending that position across the broader healthcare ecosystem (e.g., behavioral health, DSOs), a growth phase that requires the ability to proactively create new networks and relationships.

This is a relationship-led role. We are looking for someone who has spent enough time in the healthcare industry and brings a rich network of relationships with operators, associations, capital partners, and vendors who shape it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and secure strategic introductions to key healthcare operators that convert directly into qualified sales pipeline and new business opportunities
  • Define and deliver the partnership strategy that accelerates the healthcare business directly and indirectly to exceed its goals
  • Actively source partnerships that have a compounding positive impact on the business, including:

Partnership Types

  • Endorsements and co-marketing activities with industry associations
  • Referral, revenue share, and channel partnerships
  • Integrations with the systems these operators run on, including practice management, EHR, payroll, and background screening
  • Relationships with the transaction advisors, brokers, lenders, and investors who know when an operator is changing hands

 

  • Drive the deal process including negotiation, contracting, and stakeholder alignment
  • Actively contribute to the ongoing management and development of existing partners through active engagement and QBRs
  • Be a credible ambassador and public speaker for Hireology within the industry
  • Become a voice of the industry inside Hireology by attending major conferences and gathering the market and competitive intelligence that informs Sales, Marketing, and Product strategy
  • Engage with Leadership, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Business Operations, and Finance on new and ongoing initiatives

What We’re Looking For

  • Connected: You possess a deep network of healthcare operators who trust your guidance, allowing you to open doors that lead directly to measurable pipeline growth
  • In-Market Presence: You thrive on being in the field, representing Hireology at industry conferences and networking events to build and nurture high-value relationships
  • A Builder: You’ll need to demonstrate your entrepreneurial abilities in a market where the partner playbook has not been written yet
  • Results-Driven: You have a proven track record of converting industry relationships into tangible business value, with an unwavering focus on driving measurable pipeline generation
  • Works Independently and with a Team: The ideal candidate is a chameleon who can succeed both on their own and within a team-oriented, collaborative environment
  • A Problem-Solver: You will not only be identifying barriers to success, but creatively solving for those barriers in advance of them hindering our growth
  • Communication: You need to be able to tell Hireology’s story in all types of arenas and audiences, and your ability to effectively communicate in a large group setting is a major factor

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of external-facing business development, partnership, or advisory experience, with significant time spent in healthcare
  • Established relationships across healthcare operators, associations, vendors, or investors
  • Demonstrated ability to significantly increase top line revenue through influence and partner programs
  • Experience building a partnership function or channel where one did not already exist
  • Working knowledge of multi-site healthcare operating models and how hiring decisions get made across locations
  • Excellent negotiation, business model development, problem solving, and empathy skills
  • Superior verbal and written communicator that ensures parties are aligned and has the tact to keep everyone accountable to themselves and each other
  • Executive presence with ability to keynote and run facilitation sessions in front of senior industry leaders
  • Strong command with partner marketing and product development processes
  • Analytical mindset and ability to link activities to creation of measured business value
  • 2–4 years of cross-functional project or program management background
  • Travel up to 40%

A Few Benefits of Working at Hireology

  • Unlimited paid time off and mental health days
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage from day one
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Award-winning culture
  • External learning budget
  • Amazing growth opportunities and more!

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $145,000
  • OTE: $185,000

Hireology is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability status or protected veteran status, or any other category protected under the law. All employment decisions are solely based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We support an inclusive workplace where Hireologists excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

payload.name: Customer Care Specialist
payload.job_description:
Customer Care Specialist

Customer Care  •  Hireology  •  Chicago, IL  •  Hybrid  •  Full-Time

About Hireology

Hireology’s technology helps businesses build great teams. Since 2010, we’ve grown from a startup into a market-leading organization serving businesses across the country. Along the way, we’ve built an award-winning culture rooted in collaboration, innovation, and creating an exceptional experience for both our customers and our people.

About the Role

As a Customer Care Specialist, you’ll be on the front line of the Hireology customer experience, helping customers navigate questions, troubleshoot issues, and get the most out of our platform. In addition to working with our customers, this role will collaborate with our Product, Finance, and Customer Success teams. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our products, our customers, and how different parts of the business work together, while building the problem-solving and communication skills that can serve as a foundation for continued growth at Hireology.

What You Will Do

  • Respond to inbound customer questions and support requests with empathy, curiosity, and a sense of urgency.
  • Investigate customer issues to identify root causes and determine the best path toward resolution.
  • Communicate complex or technical information to customers in a way that is clear, thoughtful, and easy to understand.
  • Partner cross-functionally with teams including Product, Finance, Customer Success, and third-party vendors to resolve customer issues.
  • Take ownership of customer questions from initial investigation through resolution, keeping customers informed along the way.
  • Identify trends and recurring customer pain points and share insights that can help improve our products, processes, and overall customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

We have a pretty unique culture at Hireology, and Customer Care has evolved right alongside our products. There won’t always be a step-by-step guide telling you exactly what to do next. The people who thrive on this team are curious, resourceful, comfortable digging into the unknown, and willing to take ownership of finding the answer.

  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re comfortable when the answer isn’t immediately obvious. You enjoy investigating problems, connecting the dots, testing different approaches, and thinking outside the box to find a solution. You know when to use the resources available to you and when to pull in others for additional expertise.
  • Customer-Oriented: You approach every interaction with empathy and curiosity. You want to understand not just what a customer is asking, but what they’re ultimately trying to accomplish, and you take ownership of helping them get there.
  • Great Communicator: As a Customer Care Specialist, you’re one of the voices of Hireology to our customers. You can communicate with all types of people and businesses while remaining professional, thoughtful, transparent, and empathetic. Whether you’re explaining a simple answer or navigating a complicated issue, you make sure the customer understands what’s happening and what comes next.
  • Metrics-Driven: We’re passionate about data and trends. You understand that metrics help us measure our impact, identify opportunities, and continuously improve. You take ownership of your individual goals while balancing efficiency with providing a standout experience for every customer you support.
  • Eager to Learn: You’re curious about more than the question directly in front of you. You want to understand our product suite, our customers and industries, our internal teams, and how the pieces fit together. You use each interaction as an opportunity to build your knowledge and become a stronger resource for both customers and teammates.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience in sales, customer success, or account management is preferred
  • Must be extremely detail oriented, highly motivated, driven, self-starter

Benefits

  • Unlimited paid time off and mental health days
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage from day one
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Award-winning culture
  • Hybrid office downtown Chicago
  • External learning budget
  • Amazing growth opportunities

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $55,000 (Plus 5% Company Bonus)

Hireology is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability status or protected veteran status, or any other category protected under the law. All employment decisions are solely based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We support an inclusive workplace where Hireologists excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

payload.name: Director of Growth Marketing
payload.job_description:
Director of Growth Marketing

Marketing  •  Hireology  •  Chicago, IL  •  Hybrid  •  Full-Time

About Hireology

Hireology is a 15-year market leader in HR technology, trusted by thousands of businesses to help them hire and build outstanding teams. Recognized by Built In Chicago as a Best Place to Work multiple years running, we’re a hybrid team of committed and optimistic talent looking for the next person to help us build the future of hiring for frontline, high-volume businesses.

About the Role

As Director of Growth Marketing, you will own the strategy and team responsible for generating marketing-sourced pipeline, both new logo and expansion. You will lead a team of channel owners covering demand generation, customer marketing, partner marketing, and events, plus the agencies and vendors supporting them.

Working closely with Sales and Customer Success, you will create demand, engage priority accounts, drive adoption and expansion in the existing customer base, and improve conversion from initial interest through closed revenue. Success will be measured primarily by marketing-sourced pipeline, new logo and expansion, supported by channel efficiency, conversion, velocity, and customer acquisition cost.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Strategy & Investment

  • Translate Hireology’s growth goals into an integrated strategy for generating pipeline across new customer acquisition and expansion.
  • Own the annual and quarterly marketing-sourced pipeline target, forecast performance, identify gaps, and lead recovery plans when performance is behind plan.
  • Decide which channels and programs deserve investment, and reallocate as performance dictates.
  • Balance near-term demand capture with programs that build awareness and preference before buyers enter an active buying cycle.
  • Own the growth marketing budget and defend investment decisions with pipeline contribution, conversion, and return.
  • Ground programs in customer insight, market dynamics, performance data, and a real understanding of how frontline businesses research and buy technology.

Account-Based Marketing

  • Lead ABM programs targeting named accounts across priority verticals.
  • Partner with Sales on account selection, prioritization, messaging, and coordinated outreach.
  • Use account, intent, buyer journey, and sales data to focus resources on the accounts most likely to move.
  • Build the operating rhythm with Sales that keeps account strategy and marketing execution connected.

Customer Growth & Retention

  • Oversee the marketing programs that improve customer outcomes, including adoption, retention, advocacy, and expansion revenue.
  • Partner with Customer Success to turn product usage signals and feature launches into expansion pipeline.
  • Develop a customer advocacy and reference program that supports both expansion and new business.
  • Keep messaging consistent across the full customer journey, from first touch through renewal.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong working relationships with Sales and Customer Success leadership, anchored in shared pipeline and retention goals.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on attribution, funnel definitions, handoffs, lead scoring, routing, and reporting.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on audience insights, positioning, messaging, and campaign development.

Measurement and Operations

  • Track marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue across source, influence, conversion, and velocity.
  • Track marketing’s contribution to customer outcomes, including product adoption, retention, net revenue retention, and expansion revenue.
  • Set program and channel KPIs that connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Customer Success on the data and reporting required to measure customer health, adoption, and expansion.
  • Use performance data and experimentation to improve results and guide investment.
  • Identify gaps in the funnel and lead cross-functional efforts to address them.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Hire, manage, and develop a multidisciplinary growth marketing team.
  • Set clear goals, priorities, and accountability for direct reports.
  • Develop team members into strategic owners of their channels and programs.
  • Build the processes and operating rhythms required for effective execution.
  • Represent Growth Marketing in company planning, budget development, and quarterly OKRs.

Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or integrated marketing within B2B SaaS.
  • Experience owning pipeline strategy, budget, and performance for a sales-led mid-market motion.
  • Demonstrated success generating qualified opportunities and pipeline.
  • Experience leading integrated programs through internal teams, agencies, and cross-functional partners.
  • Proven experience building ABM programs in partnership with Sales.
  • Strong track record working with Sales leadership on pipeline planning, funnel performance, and account strategy.
  • Experience managing and developing marketers across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong command of marketing performance, funnel metrics, and investment decisions.
  • Fluency with marketing automation, CRM, attribution, and ABM or intent platforms. Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and 6sense is helpful.
  • Experience adapting marketing strategies across multiple verticals, industries, or buyer segments.
  • Comfortable operating as both a strategist and hands-on leader.

Benefits

  • Unlimited paid time off and mental health days
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage from day one
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Award-winning culture
  • Hybrid office downtown Chicago
  • External learning budget
  • Amazing growth opportunities

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $130,000–$150,000 (Plus 15% Company Bonus)

All employment decisions are solely based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We support an inclusive workplace where Hireologists excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.
